'''Imperial File #469140.33j''' was an internal [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] report which contained detailed information on events and personnel involved in the rescue of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] and the subsequent [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
